You play a magical robotic space ninja running around kicking ass.  It's stylish, fun, and free to play so give it a shot.

The Review

Warframe is one of the most impressive free-to-play games I’ve played. It combines fast-paced third-person combat, incredible movement, deep customization, and a huge amount of content. At first, the game can feel overwhelming because there are so many systems, weapons, Warframes, resources, and missions to learn, but once you get into it, it becomes extremely addictive.

The movement and combat are easily the highlights. Running across walls, sliding, jumping through levels, and using different abilities makes every mission feel fast and exciting. There are also tons of weapons and Warframes to unlock, each with their own abilities and playstyles.

The amount of content is honestly crazy, especially considering the game is free to play. You can spend hundreds of hours collecting gear, completing quests, upgrading builds, exploring different worlds, and playing with other players. The developers have also continued adding new content over the years, which gives the game a lot of longevity.

The biggest downside is that the learning curve can be pretty steep. The game doesn't always explain its systems very well, and new players can easily feel lost when trying to figure out what to do next. The grind can also become repetitive, especially when you're trying to obtain specific resources or gear.

Despite that, Warframe is an incredible game for anyone who enjoys looter-shooters, customization, and grinding for better gear. Once you understand how everything works, there is an almost ridiculous amount of content to enjoy.

Rating: 10/10
